decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display is a flexible core format close to the cardboard business, but it no longer shows on the website, which signals some risk of pruning.
The pegboard-back display serves common hanging-product promotions on existing lines, though its absence from the website since 2020 raises the chance it gets cut.
The wooden pallet sits outside the cardboard core and has not been visible since 2020, so its resources are better spent on the established business.
Physical-media displays face a shrinking segment, and the product's disappearance from the website suggests weak demand that does not justify keeping it.
